entries.title: Asterlogos

rail.alt: The Odyssey mapped in the Field — the wandering charted as constellations of thought: Troy and Ismarus, the Lotus-Eaters, Circe and the Sirens, the House of the Dead, and the way home to Ithaca.

entries.intro: Asterlogos builds interactive editions of canonical books — instruments of attention where each book is entered as the cosmos its own form implies. Not slides about the poem: the poem, made to teach from.
body: Each edition turns a book's own structure into a place you can walk into. The Odyssey opens as a logbook — fifteen knots from Troy to Ithaca, drawn as a navigable point-cloud; The Iliad holds the standing order; Hamlet's Mill, Liturgies of the Wild, and Always with Honour wait on the shelf. Around the instruments sits a commonplace-book frame: a shelf-to-field perception toggle, a trace of where you've been, and marginalia you write — loose, on a book, or placed on a knot.
Built as a static Eleventy site with THREE.js point-cloud instruments, and spun out of this practice to its own domain.

entries.title: Sanctuaire
entries.desc: One query across the world's museum collections.

film.alt: A walkthrough of Sanctuaire: one search federated across museum collections, then Wander following an artwork's threads.

entries.intro: Sanctuaire is one query across the world's museum collections — human creativity from museums around the world, distilled into context for creative work.
body: A single search federates the open-access collections of the Cleveland Museum of Art, the Art Institute of Chicago, and The Met — Rijksmuseum, Smithsonian, and Harvard built and awaiting keys — deduplicated, licence-filtered, every card carrying its attribution back to the source. Wander follows an artwork's threads — same artist, same culture, same classification — into a related constellation behind a breadcrumb trail. No accounts, no likes, no feed: only open access.
Built on Next.js 14 with no database of its own — relevance stays delegated to each museum's index. Live at sanctuaire.so.
